title: 第十五章 有仇报仇第十六章 叶枫归来
content_zh:
砰砰砰……
几声闷响传出，在幽静树林里格外的清晰，叶枫的速度快到了极点，出拳，鞭腿，力量配合内劲，至少达到了千斤。
差不多要超越赵火等人一倍。
“噗……啊……”
赵勇的身躯被重重打击了出去，就好像被奔跑的野牛撞中，脸色惨白，可叶枫却没有收手的意思，脚步继续奔近，对准他胸膛直接踩下。
咔嚓……
这一脚下去，不知有多少根肋骨变成了粉碎性骨折，顿时，赵勇连惨叫的机会都没有，直接死得不能再死了。
速度太快了。
力量又强。
根本没看清叶枫是怎么出得手，一边的赵火瞳孔中满是惊骇之意，持剑的手也是微微颤抖。
一击杀赵勇，叶枫微微有一种错觉，似乎从脚底处穿来一股热流，使得体内的万古长青脉震动了一下，不过这股热流来得快，去的更快，稍微一个激灵就让叶枫感知不到了。
“现在，轮到你了。”
叶枫也没有在意，跨前一步挡住了赵火的退路。
“你要是敢杀我，执事不会放过你的，我们整个赵家庄，姓赵的人都不会放过你。”
赵火双腿哆嗦着，色厉内荏的喝道。
“反正我已经杀了赵勇，杀一个是杀，杀两个也是杀，而且在这里杀了你，谁也不会知道是我下得手？”
叶枫步步紧逼，丝毫没有放过他的意思。
此人不死，一旦让赵天乐有所准备，反而会后患无穷。
“他娘的，叶枫，莫非你还真以为我怕了你！”
知道事情没办法善了，在叶枫嘲讽眼神注视下，赵火的神色也是恼怒起来。

“不怕，那就来！”
叶枫轻描淡写的喝道。
赵火神情变得十分凝重，他很清楚，双方已是不死不休的局面，今日一战，不是叶枫死就是他赵火亡。
“好，那老子就成全你！”
一声怒吼后，他手中短剑荡起一股犀利劲风，刺向了昂然挺立的叶枫。
这一剑带着淡淡的闪光，凌厉的破空声传出数十米之远。
武技！
毒蛇出洞！
利用内劲和身体力量攻击杀伤敌人的战法便是武技，赵火还有底气还击，最大的倚仗，那就是他修炼了武技。
哪怕只是基础剑法这样的黄阶下品武技，赵家庄也只有少数子弟才有资格学习，像方才的赵勇，就没有修炼武技的资格。
一旦用出了武技，威能大幅提升，不会武技的人很难抵挡，尤其赵火手中还握有武器，虽然方才见叶枫力量强大，行动迅速，但赵火不会以为自己就没有杀死叶枫的机会。
叶枫虽然从刁蛮少女手中得到了一本“百兽王拳”
，可没有时间修炼，所以此刻，他只能以普通招式来应对赵火的进攻。
他的眼睛全神贯注的盯着刺杀而来的短剑。
自从吞噬了许多药材之后，叶枫的感知敏锐了数倍，此时在他眼中，赵火就是一头扑来的猛兽。
content_en:
Bang bang bang...
Several muffled sounds came out, which were particularly clear in the quiet woods. Ye Feng's speed reached the extreme. He punched, whipped his legs, and combined his strength with his internal energy, reaching at least a thousand pounds.
It is almost double that of Zhao Huo and others.
"Pfft...ah..."
Zhao Yong's body was hit hard, as if he had been hit by a running bison, his face turned pale, but Ye Feng had no intention of stopping, and continued to run closer, aiming at his chest and stepping down directly.
Click...
With this kick, countless ribs became comminuted fractures. Suddenly, Zhao Yong didn't even have a chance to scream, and he died immediately.
It's too fast.
Powerful and strong.
He didn't see how Ye Feng succeeded at all. Zhao Huo's pupils on one side were full of horror, and the hand holding the sword was trembling slightly.
As soon as he killed Zhao Yong, Ye Feng had a slight illusion. It seemed that a heat flow came from the soles of his feet, causing the evergreen veins in his body to vibrate. However, this heat flow came and went faster, and Ye Feng could not feel it even with a slight stimulation.
"Now, it's your turn."
Ye Feng didn't pay attention and took a step forward to block Zhao Huo's retreat.
"If you dare to kill me, the deacon will not let you go, and no one named Zhao in our entire Zhaojiazhuang will let you go."
Zhao Huo's legs were trembling, and he shouted with a fierce expression.
"Anyway, I have already killed Zhao Yong. Killing one is killing, killing two is killing. And if I kill you here, no one will know that it was me who succeeded?"
Ye Feng pressed forward step by step, with no intention of letting him go.
If this person is not dead, once Zhao Tianle is prepared, there will be endless troubles.
"Damn it, Ye Feng, do you really think I'm afraid of you?"
Knowing that things couldn't get better, Zhao Huo also looked angry under Ye Feng's mocking gaze.
"Don't be afraid, then come!"
Ye Feng shouted lightly.
Zhao Huo's expression became very solemn. He knew very well that the two sides were in a fight to the death. In today's battle, either Ye Feng would die or he, Zhao Huo, would die.
"Okay, then I will help you!"
After a roar, the dagger in his hand whipped up a sharp force of wind and stabbed Ye Feng, who was standing proudly.
This sword had a faint flash of light, and the sharp sound of breaking through the air was heard dozens of meters away.
Martial arts!
The poisonous snake comes out of its hole!
The method of using internal strength and body strength to attack and kill the enemy is martial arts. Zhao Huo still has the confidence to fight back. The biggest reliance on him is that he has practiced martial arts.
Even if it is just a low-level yellow-level martial arts such as basic swordsmanship, only a few disciples in Zhaojiazhuang are qualified to learn it. Zhao Yong, like just now, is not qualified to practice martial arts.
Once the martial arts is used, the power is greatly increased, and it is difficult for people who do not know martial arts to resist, especially Zhao Huo who still holds a weapon in his hand. Although he has just seen that Ye Feng is powerful and moves quickly, Zhao Huo will not think that he has no chance to kill Ye Feng.
Although Ye Feng got a copy of "Fist of the King of Beasts" from the unruly girl,
, but he didn't have time to practice, so at this moment, he could only use ordinary moves to deal with Zhao Huo's attack.
His eyes were focused on the dagger coming for the assassination.
Since devouring many medicinal materials, Ye Feng's perception has become sharper several times. In his eyes, Zhao Huo is a charging beast.
